Game Overview

In Stinky Cat, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a quirky adventure with Stinky Cat, the ultimate whiskered warrior. Tap your way to stink supremacy by defeating a host of foes and upgrading your feline hero’s pungency. With every click, unleash your cat's aromatic powers and indulge in idle clicking fun as you strive to become the Stink God.
